S62.09.needs: a signed-in account with two or more tasks running
S62.09.note: The Tasks sheet lists up to 20 tasks at once, loaded when it opens (no live refresh seen in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/tasksSheet.ts).
steps: Sign in to AGI in the side panel, and start two or more tasks (the cloud tasks AGI runs for you).
Click the ⋮ button at the top of the side panel.
Look for several running tasks listed together, each with its state label and time, and compare with Expected (several running tasks or agents in one view).

S62.10.note: No client-side ordering by need for input was found in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/tasksSheet.ts: the Tasks sheet renders runs in the order the server returns them. S62.12.needs: a signed-in account with at least one task
S62.12.note: Open goes to the web chat page (/chat/<id>) rather than showing the transcript inside the extension (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/tasksSheet.ts).
steps: Sign in to AGI in the side panel and have at least one task in your history.
Click the ⋮ button at the top of the side panel, then click Tasks.
On a task row, click Open (or open the row named 'Open task: <title>').

Look at the opened page: it is the web chat for that task, showing its full transcript. Compare with Expected (full transcript drill-down from the overview). Note it opens in a browser tab on the web, not inside the side panel.
